The distance of the point (1, 3, – 7) from the plane passing through the point (1, –1, – 1), having normal perpendicular to both the lines

$${{x - 1} \over 1} = {{y + 2} \over { - 2}} = {{z - 4} \over 3}$$

and

$${{x - 2} \over 2} = {{y + 1} \over { - 1}} = {{z + 7} \over { - 1}}$$ is :
